stories.title: CPSC Recall — Harppa Nordi Foldable Toddler Tower Stools (Model HANS0002)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: CPSC RECALL: Harppa Nordi Foldable Toddler Tower Stools (Model HANS0002) — 47,166 units. Can collapse and trap a child. Free repair kit available. Details: cpsc.gov/Recalls #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Got a Harppa Nordi Toddler Tower Stool (model HANS0002, sold 2023–2026)? It's been recalled. Call 833-471-9321 or email recall@harppababy.com for a free repair kit. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

facebook.image_caption: CPSC RECALL: Harppa Nordi Foldable Toddler Tower Stools (Model HANS0002). Can collapse and trap a child. Free repair kit available — call 833-471-9321 or visit harppababy.com.

article.headline: CPSC Recalls Harppa Nordi Toddler Tower Stools Over Entrapment and Fall Hazards

stories.title: AAP 2026–27 Flu Vaccine Recommendations — All Children 6 Months and Older

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text: The AAP recommends flu vaccines for all children 6 months and older for 2026–27. Get them by end of October. First-time recipients under 8 need 2 doses 4 weeks apart. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
